name: Pick a Pear
description: In 423 Greer Creek Rd, MO, Pick a Pear grows Blueberries, Raspberries, Apples, Pears, and Corn on an independent apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
